description: The IPO pipeline from EDGAR: companies that filed or amended a registration (S-1, F-1) in a window, labelled IPO candidate, SPAC, fund or already listed, and offerings priced (424B4) with price, shares and proceeds from the prospectus cover.

days.description: Filings in the last this many days; default 30.

kind.description: ipo (default): companies with no ticker yet; spac: blank-check companies; fund: ETF and trust registrations (crypto ETFs, say); all: every S-1 and F-1, follow-ons and resales too.

priced.description: Priced offerings (424B4) to read the cover of; default 15.

name: ipo_pipeline

outputSchema.description: registrations.rows and priced.rows, newest first, in the order of their columns.

title: IPO pipeline (S-1, F-1, 424B4)
